text:
This looks like a leftover meal, so I estimated each item by what appears to remain.

- Bread slice: about 60 g, 160 kcal
- Butter: about 10 g, 70 kcal
- Yogurt cup (mostly eaten, some left): about 30 g, 25 kcal
- Soup or porridge in the bowl, remaining: about 150 g, 80 kcal
- Plate with mushrooms, egg remnants and a grilled tomato: about 60 g, 80 kcal
- Juice or wine in the glass: about 100 g, 80 kcal. I left this out because it is a drink.
- Banana peel: not food
- Dark sauce in the small cup: about 10 g, 15 kcal
- Jam or spread in the small packet: about 10 g, 25 kcal

Food total, excluding the drink: about 160 + 70 + 25 + 80 + 80 + 15 + 25 = 455 kcal. Mass: 60 + 10 + 30 + 150 + 60 + 10 + 10 = 330 g.

The photo doesn't show whether the items were fully eaten or only partly, so I'm treating the bread and the remaining portions as what's actually there. I also don't know if the bread is the full slice or part of one.

{"kcal": 450, "mass_g": 330}
